description: This Java source file defines an Android Fragment subclass called BasicImmersiveModeFragment. It manages immersive mode toggling within an Android app, including setting up system UI visibility change listeners and handling menu actions to toggle immersive mode features programmatically.

classes.name: BasicImmersiveModeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that manages immersive mode toggling and UI visibility change listening.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and indicates it has menu options.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up a listener for system UI visibility changes, logging the height of the decor view.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection to toggle immersive mode.

methods.name: toggleHideyBar
methods.description: Toggles immersive mode by changing system UI visibility flags, including immersive sticky, navigation, and full-screen flags.
